summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the abrupt departure of CEO and Chairlady Eva Yuk Yin Siu and independent director Josephine Yan Yeung, effective August 18, 2026. Both resignations were not due to disagreements. The board appointed Jiang Pengfei as Chairman and CEO, Liao Shuangwen as executive director, and Zheng Tian as independent director and committee chair. Mr. Jiang had been a director since December 2025. The changes suggest a strategic shift, though no financial terms or advisors were disclosed. Watch for further governance moves or operational strategy changes.
